game_title: Off By One Fixer – Mossy Creek Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek, a mossy forest creek: the druid must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mossy Creek: a mossy forest creek
core_gameplay_loop: In Mossy Creek, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the fixes value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 13 consecutive correct decisions about fixes to power up the druid and open the heartwood tree.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Off By One Fixer
